notes.title: Fill Up The Hole 1.10
notes.content:
- The power minigame will refresh every 2 cycles.
- The first pipe of the house will now point upward.
- When loading the game, the peon will remember the work they were doing in the power building.

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole V1.08
notes.content:
- Fix peon cost overflow
- Fix a problem with save when the demo was running before

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole V1.07
notes.content:
- The building panel will expand vertically when more options are available, removing the need to scroll.
- Once the statue is fully uncovered in Endless Mode, it will unlock the ability to purchase blue shards and books.
- Added the option to have up to three save games.
- Peon cost will be cap at 9,000,000.
- Updated the tooltip for the ending button.

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole V1.06
notes.content:
- The game should no longer freeze when a balloon carrying a large amount of trash is destroyed.
- Balloons will no longer pick up trash when positioned over the hole.
- The minigames should now be easier to click when it is in focus.

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole V1.05
notes.content:
- Display the number of completed quests on the end screen.
- The temple will stop producing RP when peons are waiting for the earthquake.
- Some settings (e.g., "View Stats") were not being saved\loaded properly.
- When loading a game, if "Building the Future" is claimed, the full tree will be displayed.
- Endless mode should now appear correctly.
- Fixed some grammatical errors.
- The "Trash+" upgrade for the helipad is now slightly more expensive.
- The flying minion doesn't descends as low.
- Attempted to fix the hole overflow issue (it's hard to reproduce, but it seems to happen when a lot of trash is being thrown).
- The hole background moves a bit more smoothly

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole 1.04
notes.content:
- When loading a game, the system will loop the quests and resubmit the achievements
- Updated the calculation to detect overflow
- Peons will no longer gather shards or books if they are already holding something
- Flying minions will no longer appear after starting a new game
- For some building upgrades, the text on the button didn't turn light gray

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole V1.03
notes.content:
Thanks to all the day-one players for their suggestions. There were some great discussions.

- Achievements should trigger as soon as they are completed
- You can zoom in and out using E and Q
- Peons will not try to collect trash that is being manually clicked
- Fixed some grammatical mistakes
- Properly reset data when a new game is created (red shard issue)
- Compressor sound now plays at the correct time and with a lower pitch
- "Extended Mode" is now a toggle instead of being hidden
- After the end animation, if someone decides to continue the game, a message will appear to enable endless mode

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole 0.20
notes.content:
- Zoom now centers on the mouse position
- Added a setting to disable the pixel font
- Fixed some bugs
- Hopefully resolved the issue where things weren't being picked up

The game wasn’t originally designed with the alternative font, but it should help players who find the pixel font difficult to read.

notes.title: Small Update – Fill Up The Hole v0.19
notes.content:
- Fixed bugs
- Made minor UI improvements (e.g., zooming in the upgrade tree)
- Balancing
- Added additional end-of-game statistics

notes.title: Update upgrade UI - Fill Up The Hole v0.18
notes.content:
- Added some quality of life features. Makes it easier to see what can be upgraded.
- Changed the music.
- Balancing.
- Fix some bugs.

notes.title: Trash in the hole - Version 0.17
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

- Fixed bugs
- Small rebalancing
- Made a few quality-of-life improvements
- Added more options in the settings

New Feature:

You can now see the garbage inside the hole. If it doesn't appear, check your settings to enable it. There may be a conflict with old save files. Hopefully this new feature doesn't not slow down the game.

notes.title: Fill Up The Hole 0.06
notes.content:
- Changed the code of buildings
- Changed the code of garbage
- Changed part of the code of peon
- Changed tool-tips
- Fix upgrades
- Updated the building cost/upgrade algorithm
- When a building is destroyed, some money if given back in the form of garbage
- Added a few more SFX

This update aims to improve overall performance and make the early game more enjoyable. For those who have already played a lot, if this patch doesn't include significant new content.

I had a good discussion about the "prestige" mechanic in the game, particularly how it encouraged players to wait rather than take action. After experimenting with a few ideas, I settled on a solution that addresses this issue. In the future, I plan to introduce upgrades that allow players to retain more resources or even gain additional resources during the prestige process.
